theme: In Dubrovnik, with a closing logistics window before the boat.
greeting: You're in Dubrovnik with an open day and no meetings, Dan. The one thing worth spending it on: everything that has to be nailed down from dry land before you board Saturday and lose signal.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the sailing instructor before Saturday
needsAttention.detail: Boarding is Sat Sept 12 (~5PM) and connectivity dies once you're underway. Confirm the exact meeting time and place, and lock the return transfer to the airport for disembark Sat Sept 19 by 8AM now, not mid-course.

needsAttention.title: Close the three Cavtat loose ends
needsAttention.detail: All three need doing from land before you board: the Komolac to Cavtat transfer (~noon Sat Sept 19), a bag hold at Remisens before 3PM check-in, and a ~5:15AM express checkout Sun Sept 20 for LH4297. The hotel's free-cancellation also ends Sept 15 while you're at sea.

needsAttention.title: Send Kerrie the AI paper she asked for
needsAttention.detail: After you sent the whistleblower doc, Kerrie Waring at CGI replied asking for the AI paper you'd referenced. Worth firing off before you go dark for a week.

flagged.title: Clarke Customer Care invoice due
flagged.detail: Appliance repair invoice from the July 31 visit is showing due. A quick one to clear before travel.

flagged.title: Nomura intermediaries thread — call still pending
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano flagged you still owe each other a call on the Nomura / Chie Mitsui work; nothing time-critical, but it hasn't been scheduled.

inbox.noise: Language lessons, market and local newsletters, and a stack of booking and boarding-pass receipts.

resolved.title: Cavtat hotel is booked
resolved.detail: Remisens Hotel Epidaurus confirmed Sept 9 (conf 5547387205), sea-view family room, breakfast in — just the transfers left.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell call is parked, not dropped
resolved.detail: You two agreed to talk after you're back on the 19th; she wished you happy sailing, so nothing is owed right now.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first winter squash and chestnuts to market — earthy, warming fare for cooler evenings.

acts.line: An open day in Dubrovnik with nothing on the calendar but your apartment stay.
The logistics window: instructor, Cavtat transfers, and the return-leg bookings all want doing while you still have signal.
Two days out from boarding the Nautilus course; anything not settled now waits until you're back on land the 19th.
